scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && npm run db:wait
scripts.db:wait: until docker compose exec -T db pg_isready -U postgres -d investment_tracker >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; echo '✅ local postgres ready on localhost:5433'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && npm run db:wait && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d investment_tracker
